item.text: The ResStock team recommends **1,000 or more samples** when further specifics about the analysis are unknown. Their rationale is that uncertainty levels off around 1,000 samples for many common quantities of interest. See [“How Many Samples are Required for this Analysis?”](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/resources/explanations/Number_of_samples.html), under “Number of Samples when Analyzing Timeseries Results.”
